# GENERATED FILE: do not hand edit. Source: tools/spellbook/build_spellbook.py + spellbook_registry.txt
# Character scope unless noted. All checks are plain variable lookups.

omni_sb_has_points = {
	has_variable = omni_spell_points
	var:omni_spell_points >= $N$
}

# The character is run by a human (their country or employer is a player).
omni_sb_belongs_to_player = {
	OR = {
		AND = { exists = employer employer = { is_ai = no } }
		AND = { exists = country country = { is_ai = no } }
	}
}

# The viewed character belongs to the player viewing the Spellbook (needs scope:player).
omni_sb_viewer_controls = {
	exists = scope:player
	OR = {
		AND = { exists = employer employer = scope:player }
		AND = { exists = country country = scope:player }
	}
}

# Shown in the Spellbook mage list: has studied, is a mage, or holds points.
omni_sb_listable_mage = {
	OR = {
		has_variable = omni_spell_points
		has_trait = mage_trait
		has_trait = archmage_trait
		has_trait = grand_archmage_trait
		has_trait = magus_supreme_trait
		omni_sb_any_t1_access = yes
		has_variable = folk_unlocked_var
		has_trait = vampire_trait
	}
}
